name: Blue and white theme with SkillBridge logo
description: Apply client colours and logo to Navbar, Hero, Footer and CourseCard. Simplify English copy on the home page.

name: Course details page with chapter and lecture accordion
description: Show courseContent chapters with their lectures, durations and the free preview link. Preview opens the YouTube player in place of the thumbnail.

name: Stripe purchase flow in INR with webhook
description: Set CURRENCY to INR, create the Purchase record before redirecting to Stripe, and complete enrolment in the stripeWebhooks handler on payment success. Verify the webhook signature.

name: Show discounted price and percentage on course cards
description: Decided on 5 August: show rupee price after discount, original price struck through and the percentage off, on CourseCard and CourseDetails.

name: Educator dashboard: earnings and enrolled students
description: Client wants only total earnings and enrolled students per course. Remove other sample widgets.

name: Clarify what 'slow and non-responsive' means
description: Client keeps saying the site feels slow and non-responsive. Could be mobile layout, scroll or animation lag on his Redmi, or course pages loading slowly from the API. Ask for page, device and a screen recording, and test on a low-end Android before changing code.

name: Find out where the client's email is hosted
description: Before touching GoDaddy DNS, confirm the email provider and note the current MX, SPF and other TXT records. Client's staff member Ganesh set it up. Do not change nameservers.

name: Production Vercel projects and environment variables
description: Create production projects for client and server folders using their vercel.json files. Set Clerk, Stripe, MongoDB and Cloudinary variables. Add production webhook endpoints in the Clerk and Stripe dashboards.

name: Connect GoDaddy domain to Vercel
description: Add the domain in Vercel and create only the records Vercel asks for in GoDaddy DNS. Leave all mail records as they are. Go-live date agreed with client is 25 September.

name: Handover document and walkthrough video
description: Write a short guide for teachers on adding a course and for the director on reading the dashboard. List every account and who owns it.
